<a id="page-entry"></a>

## About this page

What an item's page shows: the buttons at the top, how its fields behave, and how many old passwords it keeps.

#### How it works

**Buttons at the top** are the copy and open buttons under the item's name. **Fields** changes how secrets are shown and copied. **History** is kept in the vault itself, so it applies on every device that opens it.

See also [Item view](/guide/screens/#screen-item), [Codes](/guide/settings/codes/), [Clear the clipboard after](/guide/settings/security/#setting-clipboard-seconds).

<a id="setting-entry-actions"></a>

## Show them

Shows buttons under an item's name to copy its password, copy its username and open its website.

#### How it works

**Copy password** shows whenever the item has a password. The other two have their own switches below.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| On | The buttons show on every item that has something for them. |
| Off | No buttons. You can still copy from each field. |

#### On Android

In the Glass style these buttons are always shown.

See also [Copy username](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-entry-action-username), [Open site](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-entry-action-open).

<a id="setting-entry-action-username"></a>

## Copy username

Adds a **Copy username** button at the top of items that have a username.

#### On Android

In the Glass style this button is always shown.

See also [Show them](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-entry-actions).

<a id="setting-entry-action-open"></a>

## Open site

Adds an **Open site** button that opens the item's first website in your browser.

#### On Android

In the Glass style this button is always shown.

See also [Show them](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-entry-actions).

<a id="setting-tap-copies"></a>

## Click a field to copy it

Copies a field's value when you click on it, as well as with its copy button.

#### How it works

A hidden secret is copied without being shown. Once a secret is on show, a click no longer copies it, so you can select part of it. Selecting text in any field copies nothing.

#### Limits

Passwords and other hidden fields are cleared from the clipboard after the time under [Clear the clipboard after](/guide/settings/security/#setting-clipboard-seconds). A username or another plain field stays until you copy something else.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Tap a field to copy it.

Copies a field's value when you tap it, as well as with its copy button.

A hidden secret is copied without being shown.

See also [Clear the clipboard after](/guide/settings/security/#setting-clipboard-seconds), [Copying secrets](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-clipboard).

<a id="setting-reveal-seconds"></a>

## Hide shown secrets after

How long a password or another secret you have shown stays on screen before it goes back to dots.

#### How it works

The time counts from the last secret you showed or hid. Leaving the item hides everything at once.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 15 seconds | Long enough to read it once. |
| 45 seconds | Time to read it out or type it on another device. |
| 2 minutes | For copying a long secret by hand. |
| Leaving | Secrets stay shown until you leave the item or the vault locks. |

#### On Android

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 15 s | Long enough to read it once. |
| 45 s | Time to read it out or type it on another device. |
| 2 min | For copying a long secret by hand. |
| Leaving | Secrets stay shown until you leave the item or the vault locks. |

See also [Block screenshots](/guide/settings/security/#setting-screen-protection), [Color digits and symbols](/guide/settings/entry/#setting-colour-secrets).

<a id="setting-colour-secrets"></a>

## Color digits and symbols

Draws the digits and symbols of a shown password in their own colors, apart from the letters.

#### Why it is there

Reading a password aloud, or typing it on a television, goes wrong where a 1 looks like an l. Color shows at a glance which characters are digits and which are symbols.

#### How it works

It applies to secrets on show on an item's page and to the generator's value.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Avoid look-alikes](/guide/settings/generator/#setting-gen-no-ambiguous).

<a id="action-history-keep"></a>

## Old passwords to keep

How many earlier passwords each item keeps in its history, which you can see and copy on the item's page.

#### How it works

Changing a password puts the old one in history. If two devices change the same secret before they sync, the value that loses is kept there too.

The number counts for each field. When an item has more than that, its oldest values go the next time the item changes.

#### Limits

This is stored in the vault, not on this device, so it applies on every device that opens the vault.

A new vault keeps every old value. That shows here as 0 until you choose a number.

See also [Item view](/guide/screens/#screen-item), [Keeping devices in sync](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-sync).
